label.en: Proceeds from disposal of non-current assets (+)

currentTwLabel: 處分不動產、廠房及設備
ifrsEnglish: Proceeds from disposal of non-current assets

note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸列，模板沒有；金額不為零時才顯示，並標「模板無此列」。
note.en: An extension row added by the site. The template has no such line; it is shown only when the amount is not nil, marked as absent from the template.

definition.zh-TW: 賣掉設備等長期資產時收到的現金。處分的利益或損失留在損益表，這裡記的是收到的全部價款。
definition.en: Cash received when equipment or another long-term asset is sold. Any gain or loss stays in the income statement; this line records the full proceeds.
